_comment: Test fixture loaded by tests/run-tests.sh via --settings. --settings MERGES on top of the developer's live ~/.claude/settings.json — it does not replace it. Drift detection in tests/check-structure.sh (Phase 7) FILTERS host-specific claudesk hooks from both sides, then enforces that NO field outside _intentional_diffs_from_live differs, so the merge produces predictable behaviour. To change live settings, edit ~/.claude/settings.json and re-run check-structure.sh; it will tell you if the fixture needs updating.
_intentional_diffs_from_live: (none) — as of the 2026-07-29 claude-time retirement there are no intentional hook diffs. The tool's hook was the only repo-owned hook in live settings; with it gone, every event's remaining entries are host-specific claudesk hooks, which Phase 7 STRIPS from both sides before comparing. So both sides reduce to empty hook lists and are diffed exactly.

NOTE: claudesk hooks (the developer's wrapper app, com.claudesk.app[.dev]) are present in live on all 10 events but are stripped from both sides by Phase 7 — they are host-specific, mutate on claudesk's own schedule, and are not tracked here.
